document.title: Holidays abroad instead of at home
document.question:
Many people now prefer to spend their holidays abroad rather than travelling within their own country. Some say foreign trips offer better value and new experiences, while others feel that people are missing the attractions on their doorstep.

Why do many people prefer to travel abroad? How could domestic tourism be made more attractive?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
